item.title: Remaining FNM candidates to be ratified before Valentine’s Day, says Pintard
item.description: FREE National Movement leader Michael Pintard said the party is preparing to move swiftly through its remaining candidate approvals.

item.title: Uber proposal ‘soundly rejected’ by taxi union
item.description: THE Bahamas Taxi Cab Union has flatly rejected any partnership with ride-sharing giant Uber, with union president Tyrone Butler saying the proposal was “not something that was welcome” by taxi drivers.

item.title: Two officers face disciplinary tribunal over bribery claims
item.description: POLICE Commissioner Shanta Knowles said two police officers are facing disciplinary proceedings before the police tribunal after a viral video appeared to show an officer attempting to solicit a bribe from a tourist during a traffic stop.

item.title: Mitchell to PLPs: No need to talk to reporters
item.description: Foreign Affairs Minister and PLP Chairman Fred Mitchell has told Progressive Liberal Party politicians that they should not feel compelled to answer questions from the press.

item.title: ‘Weak enforcement’ fuels stray dog crisis
item.description: IN most wealthy countries, stray dogs are rare.

item.title: 'GB Power deal a political stunt'
item.description: The Government was yesterday accused of treating Grand Bahama residents as “puppets” by generating more questions than answers over its announced ambitions to acquire the island’s electricity monopoly.

item.title: Gale-force winds, dangerous seas and near-record cold to hit The Bahamas this weekend
item.description: STRONG gale-force winds, dangerous marine conditions and near-record low temperatures are forecast to impact The Bahamas this weekend into early next week.

item.title: Davis and Pintard clash over carbon credit legislation
item.description: PRIME Minister Philip “Brave” Davis and Opposition leader Michael Pintard yesterday offered sharply different assessments of the government’s carbon credit agenda as Parliament debated new legislation intended to consolidate climate policy and monetise The Bahamas’ environmental assets.

item.title: Three year sentence for guilty plea over loaded Glock pistol
item.description: A MAN who admitted to having a loaded pistol in his Major Road home last week was sentenced to three years in prison.

item.title: Govt assessing PMH operations after nurses fail to report for duty
item.description: THE Government is assessing operations at Princess Margaret Hospital today following reports that some nurses did not report for duty amid ongoing tensions over unpaid overtime.
